newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Oct 19.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Oct 19.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crush totalled 1.799 million tonnes in the week ended October 19, up from 1.594 million tonnes in the previous week, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said.
CANEGROWERS reported for crushing week 20 of the 1996 season that average commercial cane sugar (ccs) content fell to 14.19 percent from 14.43 percent the week before.
The latest week brought this year's crush to 30.88 million tonnes, up from 26.53 million tonnes at the same time in 1995.
Australian sugar cane crush by region for the week ended October 19 as reported by CANEGROWERS in tonnes.
The 1995 crush started on June 13 and ended by December 30.
CCS = Commercial Cane Sugar (sugar content percent)-

NOTE: Estimated 1996 cane crop: Australia 40,129,000 tonnes. Queensland 37,891,000, New South Wales 2,238,000.

1995 Summary - Total cane crushed 37.389 million tonnes (Qld 35.295 million, NSW 2.094 million), sugar produced 4.98 million tonnes 94 n.t., (Qld 4.73 million, NSW 244,629), sugar content (CCS) 13.12 percent (Qld 13.22 percent, NSW 11.41 percent).
